headline: Oil Pulls Back From Six-Month Highs as Asian Shares Open Cautiously
summary: Oil prices fell from six-month highs even as Saudi attacks kept supply concerns in focus. Asian equity markets made a cautious start as Brent crude eased.
why: Crude oil is a primary global energy benchmark that directly impacts inflation expectations, corporate operating costs, and central bank policy worldwide.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Crude prices pulled back from six-month highs despite ongoing supply risks.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Energy equities tend to track pullbacks in global crude benchmarks.

why_moved: Oil prices eased from six-month highs during cautious Asian trading, though supply concerns tied to Saudi attacks limited further declines.
